heading: Hook Files and the Custom Folder
text:
### Typeahead Option Getters

A string input with the typeahead flag renders `TextWithTypeAhead`, an autocomplete with `freeSolo` enabled (free text is allowed). The page's custom hooks can provide the suggestions through a getter named `get<AttributeName>Options`, where `<AttributeName>` is the input's attribute name with its first letter upper-cased (for example `getForm_<field>Options` for the attribute `form_<field>`):

```ts
get<AttributeName>Options?: (
  searchText: string,
  data: <Data>,
  editMode: boolean,
  validation: Map<keyof <Data>, string>
) => Promise<string[]>;
```

The getter is optional and returns the list of suggestion strings.

heading: AuthenticationInterceptor Interface
text:
`AuthenticationInterceptor` has three methods, called at two different points:

- `authenticate(operationFQName, exchange, claim, realm, client, attributes)` runs at the start of **every** dispatcher operation call that has a principal, before the mapped principal is loaded. It is called on every registered interceptor; `isSuitableForOperation` is **not** consulted, so filter on `operationFQName`, `client` or `claim` inside the method.
- `isSuitableForOperation(operation, claim, realm, client, attributes)` is only the filter for `success`.
- `success(operation, signedIdentifier, exchange, claim, realm, client, attributes)` runs after the access checks of the operation and before the operation body, only on interceptors whose `isSuitableForOperation` returns `true`.

Both `authenticate` and `success` default to no-ops.
evidence: runtime__judo-runtime-core/judo-runtime-core-dispatcher/src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/runtime/core/dispatcher/DefaultDispatcher.java:620-626, DefaultActorResolver.java:83-103; judo-runtime-core-accessmanager/.../DefaultAccessManager.java:131-152; judo-runtime-core-accessmanager-api/.../AuthenticationInterceptor.java:11-58. Note: finding wording 'runs on authentication events, not operations' is inaccurate; authenticate runs per operation call when a principal exists. Also add the missing `success` method to the interface listing at authentication-guide.md:31-35

heading: Resolution order (`DefaultActorResolver`)
text:
- The lookup attribute is an actor attribute whose `claim` is `USERNAME` or `EMAIL`, or one whose name equals a token claim key **and** that maps to an entity identifier attribute. A mapped actor with no such attribute fails with `IllegalStateException` ("ID attribute in Entity type matching any access token claim not found").
- `authenticateByPrincipal` builds the claims map from the string-valued token attributes only; non-string claims are ignored for the lookup.
- The lookup value is coerced to the attribute type (string, numeric, date, time, timestamp, boolean, enumeration by literal); other types log a warning and run the search without a filter.
- Transient actor attributes whose name equals a claim key receive the claim value on the actor payload.

heading: Response Metadata and Wire Conversion
text:
- Enumeration values are stored and sent as the member ordinal. An ordinal that is not a member of the enumeration is rejected: the response conversion throws `IllegalArgumentException` ("Invalid enumeration value '<n>' of type <FQN>"), the request conversion throws it for an unknown literal, and a query-customizer filter with an unknown ordinal throws "Invalid enumeration member".
- JQL compares two values of the same enumeration with `==`, `!=`, `<`, `>`, `<=` and `>=`; comparing different enumerations is rejected ("Operands are not of the same enumeration").
- The generated SDK enum has `getOrdinal()`, `getName()` and a static `getByOrdinal(Integer)`; `getByOrdinal` throws `IllegalArgumentException` ("Invalid ordinal: <n>") for null or an unknown ordinal.

heading: Excel Export Operations
text: `Export` is bound to `UnsupportedExportImpl` by default in the Guice module and in the Spring configuration; every method throws `UnsupportedOperationException("Not implemented")`, so an `EXPORT` operation fails until `JxlsExport` is supplied. In the Karaf platform `DefaultJxlsExportComponent` registers `JxlsExport`; in a Guice setup pass it as the `export` of the module configuration. `JxlsExport` implements only the `AsmModel`/FQN variants; the `Class`-based `exportToInputStream` throws `UnsupportedOperationException`.

heading: Custom REST Endpoints and CXF
text: - Each CXF bus is a `CxfContext` component (`configurationPolicy=REQUIRE`, required `busId`). Its optional keys are `interceptors.in.components`, `interceptors.out.components` and `interceptors.fault.components` (OSGi filters selecting `org.apache.cxf.interceptor.Interceptor` services), `metrics.enabled` and `logging.enabled` (both default `false`), `wadl.service.description.available` (default `true`) and `skip.default.json.provider.registration` (default `true`). The application manager creates the default bus `DEFAULT_CXF_BUS_FOR_JAXRS_APPLICATIONS`; a `BasicApplication` can use another context through its optional `CxfContext` reference.

Config key spelling with dots is the OSGi mapping of the underscore attribute names (interceptors_in_components); verify in a running container

heading: Signed Identifiers
text: Instance ids come from the `IdentifierProvider` SPI (`get()`, `getType()`, `getName()`). The default `UUIDIdentifierProvider` returns random `UUID`s of type `UUID` and names the payload key `__identifier`. The Guice module binds it unless the module configuration supplies another `IdentifierProvider`.
